items.name: standings-feature
items.title: Standings Feature
items.description: Feature Section built with Standings (animated leaderboard): apps race to rank for each keyword. A take on the leaderboard (ranking). A keyword-tracking feature section. On the left, the keywords an app could rank for, each with its monthly searches, the app's rank and how far it moved; on the right, the race for the picked keyword. Pick another and the same six apps slide to their new places, with a suggestion for how to climb under them. The keywords play by themselves, a line under the current one filling like a timer, until the visitor picks one.

Under the card, three notes on how the integrations work.
